rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and ZIP, matched to a single user account, then retrieved user details and inspected recent orders with read-only tools. It identified the two delivered orders containing tablets and asked the user to choose which item to return and the refund destination. Before making any changes, the agent clearly summarized the exact action and requested explicit confirmation. After the user changed their mind and confirmed returning the gold 128GB tablet with refund to the gift card, the agent executed the return via the tool with the correct order ID, item ID, and refund method. The tool result shows status updated to return requested for the correct item and refund method. Final communication accurately reflects the tool outcome. No unsupported claims, wrong actions, or policy violations were observed.
